_comment: Canonical OrgArchitecture for Unicron Internal, Pathfinder organization #4. Persisted into pathfinder.organizations.architecture (jsonb). Consumed by resolveArchitecture() and POST /api/organizations. This instance is Pathfinder pointed inward: Unicron runs it on itself to fill the Pathfinder new-business pipeline. Weights, taxonomy, and vocabulary are drafts for Kyle and the Architect to tune. 'Unicron Internal' is a working display name; redline before launch. Org row fields: name='Unicron Internal', slug='internal', customer_org_id='unicron-internal'. Served at internal.unicron.systems (vanity domain aliased to the /internal route).

outreach.persona: new-business sales rep at Unicron Systems selling the Pathfinder lead-intelligence service
outreach.tone: direct, peer-to-peer, operator-credible, names the prospect's own prospecting pain, no fluff
outreach.value_prop: a ranked, outreach-ready pipeline of qualified construction-vertical leads delivered every morning, so reps stop prospecting by hand

business_summary.lead_type: A verified, ranked company profile for a construction-vertical B2B service provider (site-services companies), confirmed to have an active sales team, multi-region operations, and revenue tied to new construction starts.
business_summary.business_area: Unicron's own sales team uses these leads to fill the Pathfinder new-business pipeline, working a pre-ranked, outreach-ready list each morning instead of prospecting manually.
business_summary.problem_solved: Unicron's reps currently prospect by hand into a fragmented market of tens of thousands of construction-vertical firms, the same pain their own product solves for customers. This deployment turns Pathfinder inward, so the Unicron team reaches the right companies before competitors do, with a message that names the pain those companies already feel.
business_summary.what_they_get: Every morning, the Unicron sales team receives a ranked list of the day's best-fit target companies, each one enriched with headquarters location, operating footprint, sales-team evidence, and a note on any warm introduction available through shared trade-association or existing-customer connections. Three ready-to-send outreach drafts (email, LinkedIn message, and an internal HubSpot note) are pre-written for each company. The top leads are surfaced in a daily Slack digest and automatically loaded into the Pathfinder pipeline kanban at the New / Outreach Ready stage.
